item.content:encoded: I do agree with these statements, but I'd like to point out that Aelanna/MacKenzie hasn't had any activity on Wikidot since October and likely won't be doing anything with the Foundation wiki for a long time. I know an IRC channel she uses frequently, but she might still respond to PMs on Wikidot and can probably respond to PMs through IRC.

item.content:encoded: Alright, since this is an artpage now, I'd argue that the number of drawings actually related to the Foundation is weak, and being a place to find the high-res logo doesn't really add much.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I got this page up off the "random SCP" button. I just hoped that someone pointing out "this art is kinda cool, would be nice to see some more actual content on it" might spur the author to produce some more content.

item.content:encoded:
Apparently you have the time to dig up peoples' shit from four years ago but don't bother to notice the fact that a) it's a sandbox, and I wasn't aware that voting even means anything on sandboxes created before the contemporary ban, and b) that high-res version of the logo didn't exist until I traced a vector off of the old PDF template three years ago.

Go bother someone else with your necromancy.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: On the one hand, this page is kinda sparse, and since the SCP logo doesn't really count there are only three SCP-related pictures I can see here, and one of them is just the most obscure thing. On the other hand, I really like that a fanart drawing of 8-ball exists. But… unlike Kens page, which has a shitton of content and definitely justifies its existence, this one kinda doesn't. I'd love to have the art preserved somewhere, or this page expanded to make it more worthy of having its own space.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I love the drawings, which are very well executed and whatnot. Sadly, you also seem to suffer from the Six Faces Syndrome. Maybe it's the simplicity of the art style, or the similar expressions & pose between Dr. Mackenzie & 8-ball, but I feel that one could be perfectly well be the other in costume. Cassie, while also similar-looking, holds enough difference in eye details & expression for someone to think it really is someone else.
